# Craft Beer School

> Craft Beer School is an India-based beer school teaching brewing, tasting, branding and the business of beer, online and in person. Based in Bengaluru, serving learners across India and worldwide.

## Courses

- [Brewing Fundamentals](https://craftbeerschool.in/brewing-fundamentals-course.html): The science of brewing: ingredients, equipment and technique. Live online sessions, plus your first real recipe. Duration 4 Weeks. Price INR 5999.
- [Advanced Brewing Science](https://craftbeerschool.in/advanced-brewing-science-course.html): Go deeper into brewing chemistry, microbiology and fermentation. For serious homebrewers and professionals. Duration 6 Weeks. Price INR 12999.
- [Brewery Business Management](https://craftbeerschool.in/brewery-business-management-course.html): The business behind the brew: plan, launch and grow a brewery, from finance to distribution. Duration 3 Weeks. Price INR 8999.
- [Style Specialisation](https://craftbeerschool.in/style-specialization-course.html): Master IPAs, stouts, lagers, sours and Belgian ales: their history, technique and award-winning examples. Duration 8 Weeks. Price INR 18999.
- [Beer Branding and Packaging](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-branding-packaging-course.html): Build a beer brand that stands out and packaging that sells. Made for aspiring brewers and founders. Duration 3 Weeks. Price INR 4999.
- [Sensory Evaluation](https://craftbeerschool.in/sensory-evaluation-course.html): Train your palate like a pro: taste, identify off-flavours and score beer with real sensory methods. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5999.
- [AI for Craft Breweries](https://craftbeerschool.in/ai-for-craft-breweries-course.html): Put GenAI to work on your brewery's copy, social posts and weekly admin and use it responsibly. No coding needed. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Digital Transformation Basics for Brewing](https://craftbeerschool.in/digital-transformation-basics-for-brewing-course.html): Move your brewery off paper and into simple digital tools: brew logs, stock, batch tracking and a dashboard you will actually open. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [ESG in Craft Brewing](https://craftbeerschool.in/esg-in-craft-brewing-course.html): Water, energy, spent grain, packaging, people and governance: measure what your brewery does and tell the story honestly. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Safety in Brewing](https://craftbeerschool.in/safety-in-brewing-course.html): The hazards that hurt people in breweries and how to work around them: CO2, chemicals, heat, pressure and confined spaces. Duration 1 Week. Free (price INR 0).
- [Craft Distilling](https://craftbeerschool.in/craft-distilling-course.html): From wash to bottle: stills, cuts, gin botanicals, ageing in Indian heat and the licences a craft distillery needs. Duration 4 Weeks. Price INR 9999.
- [Craft Gin Making](https://craftbeerschool.in/craft-gin-making-course.html): Design and make a gin of your own: juniper and botanicals, the still run, proofing and getting a bottle to market in India. Duration 4 Weeks. Price INR 9999.
- [RTD Drinks: Alcoholic and Non-Alcoholic](https://craftbeerschool.in/rtd-drinks-alcoholic-and-non-alcoholic-course.html): Ready-to-drink cans and bottles, with and without alcohol: formulation, sweetness and acid, carbonation, shelf life and the rules. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Hop Water](https://craftbeerschool.in/hop-water-course.html): Sparkling water with all the aroma of hops and none of the alcohol. Make it on brewery kit and keep it stable on the shelf. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Hard Seltzer](https://craftbeerschool.in/hard-seltzer-course.html): A clean, dry sugar ferment turned into a light, fruity seltzer: base, yeast nutrition, clarity, flavour and the rules in India. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Kombucha](https://craftbeerschool.in/kombucha-course.html): Brew kombucha safely and consistently, from tea, sugar and culture to flavoured, sparkling bottles for a cafe or taproom. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Non-Alcoholic Beer](https://craftbeerschool.in/non-alcoholic-beer-course.html): Beer that still tastes like beer, without the alcohol: limited fermentation, special yeasts, body and aroma, plus keeping it safe on the shelf. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Power BI and Tableau for Breweries](https://craftbeerschool.in/power-bi-and-tableau-for-breweries-course.html): Build the dashboards a brewery actually opens: brew logs, yield, losses, stock and sales in Power BI or Tableau, from your own spreadsheets. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Winemaking](https://craftbeerschool.in/winemaking-course.html): Grape to bottle: harvest numbers, crushing and pressing, red and white fermentation, malolactic, clarifying and bottling, for Indian vineyards and climate. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Fortified Wine](https://craftbeerschool.in/fortified-wine-course.html): How port-style, sherry-style and other fortified wines are made: fortifying with grape spirit, sweetness, oxidative ageing and blending. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Winery Business](https://craftbeerschool.in/winery-business-course.html): Run a small winery as a business: costing a bottle, licences and excise, route to market, cellar door and wine tourism in India. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [New Product Development: Beer, Whisky and Wine](https://craftbeerschool.in/new-product-development-beer-whisky-and-wine-course.html): Take a new beer, whisky or wine from idea to launch: consumer insight, formulation, pilot batches, sensory testing, costing, labels and launch. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Digital Marketing for Breweries](https://craftbeerschool.in/digital-marketing-for-breweries-course.html): Market a brewery online inside India's alcohol advertising rules: Instagram, WhatsApp, Google listings and content that fills a taproom. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Brand Strategy and Positioning for Breweries](https://craftbeerschool.in/brand-strategy-and-positioning-for-breweries-course.html): Work out who your brewery is for and why it is different, then write it down so every label, post and pint says the same thing. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Rebranding a Brewery](https://craftbeerschool.in/rebranding-a-brewery-course.html): Plan a rebrand that keeps the drinkers you have: audit, goals, budget, the design brief and a roll-out timed to new labels and approvals. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Naming and Trademarks for Drinks Brands](https://craftbeerschool.in/naming-and-trademarks-for-drinks-brands-course.html): Find a brewery or beer name people can say, spell and remember, then check it is free to use before you print a single label. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.
- [Taproom Marketing and Community](https://craftbeerschool.in/taproom-marketing-and-community-course.html): Turn first visits into regulars: events, beer clubs, staff who live the brand and local partnerships for a taproom or brewpub. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5000.

## Guides

- [A beer trip to Prague and Pilsen for lager lovers](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-beer-trip-to-prague-and-pilsen-for-lager-lovers.html): How to plan a lager lover's beer trip to Prague and Pilsen: Czech pours, degrees on the menu, tank beer and visiting the home of pale lager.
- [A bottling line for a craft distillery](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-bottling-line-for-a-craft-distillery.html): How to plan a bottling line for a small whisky distillery: the steps, manual versus automatic kit, fill accuracy and safety.
- [A career as a distillery QC chemist](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-career-as-a-distillery-qc-chemist.html): What a distillery quality control chemist does, the tests they run from molasses to bottle and how to move into the role in India.
- [A career as a whisky warehouse manager](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-career-as-a-whisky-warehouse-manager.html): What a whisky warehouse manager does, the skills the job needs and how the role works in India's heat and excise system.
- [A career in whisky marketing](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-career-in-whisky-marketing.html): What whisky marketers in India actually do, the rules they work within and the product knowledge that sets the good ones apart.
- [A career in whisky sales](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-career-in-whisky-sales.html): What whisky sales jobs in India involve: retail and bar visits, state routes to market, schemes, numbers and the product knowledge that helps.
- [A craft beer trip to the US West Coast](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-craft-beer-trip-to-the-us-west-coast.html): How to plan a craft beer trip to the US West Coast: which cities to visit, West Coast IPA, taproom habits, tipping and getting around safely.
- [A distillery business plan from grain to glass](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-distillery-business-plan-from-grain-to-glass.html): How to build a whisky distillery business plan: capacity in LPA, the cash gap while whisky ages, what to sell meanwhile and the numbers lenders check.
- [A horizontal whisky tasting by region](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-horizontal-whisky-tasting-by-region.html): How to run a horizontal whisky tasting across regions: picking comparable bottles, the order to taste and what regional style really tells you.
- [A pub trip around Britain for cask ale lovers](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-pub-trip-around-britain-for-cask-ale-lovers.html): How to plan a pub trip around Britain for cask ale: how real ale is served, ordering at the bar, finding good pubs and getting around by train.
- [A seasonal brewpub in a tourist town and how to survive the off season](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-seasonal-brewpub-in-a-tourist-town-and-how-to-survive-the.html): How a brewpub in a tourist town plans cash, beer, staff and local trade to get through the off season without burning the profits of the peak months.
- [A ten minute daily aroma practice for beer lovers at home](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-ten-minute-daily-aroma-practice-for-beer-lovers-at-home.html): A simple ten minute daily aroma practice for beer lovers at home, using kitchen spices and fruit to train your nose for beer aromas.
- [A vertical tasting of one distillery](https://craftbeerschool.in/a-vertical-tasting-of-one-distillery.html): How to run a vertical whisky tasting of one distillery: choosing bottles, setting the order and what to look for as age and cask change.
- [Abbey and Trappist beer explained](https://craftbeerschool.in/abbey-and-trappist-beer-explained.html): The difference between Trappist and abbey beer, what the Authentic Trappist Product label means and the styles to know.
- [Acidulated malt or lactic acid for mash pH](https://craftbeerschool.in/acidulated-malt-or-lactic-acid-for-mash-ph.html): How acidulated malt and lactic acid lower mash pH, the 1% rule of thumb, flavour limits and how to choose between them.
- [Activated carbon filters for brewing water](https://craftbeerschool.in/activated-carbon-filters-for-brewing-water.html): How activated carbon removes chlorine and chloramine, how to size contact time plus the maintenance that stops a carbon bed growing bacteria.
- [Adding a second brewing shift as sales grow](https://craftbeerschool.in/adding-a-second-brewing-shift-as-sales-grow.html): When a growing brewery should add a second shift, what it changes in tanks, utilities and staff, how to cost it and how to hand over safely.
- [Adding sugar syrup in the kettle](https://craftbeerschool.in/adding-sugar-syrup-in-the-kettle.html): When to add sugar or syrup to the kettle, how much it raises gravity and the yeast and flavour limits that keep the beer dry rather than thin.
- [Adjusting a recipe when you miss your original gravity](https://craftbeerschool.in/adjusting-a-recipe-when-you-miss-your-original-gravity.html): What to do when homebrew wort comes in under or over target gravity: boil longer, add extract or sugar, top up or adjust the next recipe.
- [Aerating wort at home by shaking, splashing or pure oxygen](https://craftbeerschool.in/aerating-wort-at-home-by-shaking-splashing-or-pure-oxygen.html): Shaking, splashing or pure oxygen: how much oxygen homebrew yeast needs at pitching, what each method achieves and when dry yeast needs none.
- [Aftertaste and finish and how to describe the length of a beer](https://craftbeerschool.in/aftertaste-and-finish-and-how-to-describe-the-length-of-a.html): How to describe a beer's aftertaste and finish: what length means, which compounds linger and simple words for short, medium and long finishes.
- [Ageing beer bottles upright or on their side](https://craftbeerschool.in/ageing-beer-bottles-upright-or-on-their-side.html): Should you age beer upright or on its side? What crown caps, corks, yeast sediment and oxygen mean for how bottles are stored.
- [Ageing beer in Indian heat when you have no cool room](https://craftbeerschool.in/ageing-beer-in-indian-heat-when-you-have-no-cool-room.html): How to age or store beer at home in Indian heat with no cool room: what to keep, what to skip and the cheapest ways to keep bottles cooler.
- [Ageing Belgian quadrupel and strong dark ales at home](https://craftbeerschool.in/ageing-belgian-quadrupel-and-strong-dark-ales-at-home.html): How Belgian quadrupels and strong dark ales change with age, how long to keep them and how to store them in an Indian home.
- [Ageing lambic and sour beer at home over several years](https://craftbeerschool.in/ageing-lambic-and-sour-beer-at-home-over-several-years.html): Which lambics and sour beers reward years in the bottle, how to store them at home in India and what changes to expect as they age.
- [Alcohol and medicines and why you should ask before drinking](https://craftbeerschool.in/alcohol-and-medicines-and-why-you-should-ask-before-drinking.html): Why beer and medicines can clash, the common types of medicine that carry alcohol warnings and the simple questions to ask a pharmacist.
- [Alcohol measurement by density meter or distillation](https://craftbeerschool.in/alcohol-measurement-by-density-meter-or-distillation.html): How breweries measure alcohol: gravity calculations, distillation with density readings and instrument methods, with the accuracy of each.
- [American and Canadian rye whisky compared](https://craftbeerschool.in/american-and-canadian-rye-whisky-compared.html): How American rye and Canadian rye whisky differ: the legal rules, the grain content, the casks and what each tends to taste like.
- [American oak versus European oak](https://craftbeerschool.in/american-oak-versus-european-oak.html): How American and European oak casks differ in species, grain, tannin and flavour and how to taste the difference in whisky.
- [American single malt explained](https://craftbeerschool.in/american-single-malt-explained.html): What American single malt whiskey is, how its rules differ from Scotch and bourbon and what flavours to expect from the style.
- [Antifoam in fermenters](https://craftbeerschool.in/antifoam-in-fermenters.html): How silicone antifoam works in fermenters, what it does to fill volume and foam on the finished beer, how to dose it and regulatory checks in India.
- [Antifoam in whisky fermentation](https://craftbeerschool.in/antifoam-in-whisky-fermentation.html): Why whisky washbacks foam, when to use antifoam or mechanical foam breakers, how to dose it and what it does downstream in the wash still.
- [Artwork change workflow for beer packaging teams](https://craftbeerschool.in/artwork-change-workflow-for-beer-packaging-teams.html): How a beer label or can artwork change moves from brief to printed stock in India, including excise label approval, proofs and old stock run-out.
- [Aseptic fruit purees in a small brewery](https://craftbeerschool.in/aseptic-fruit-purees-in-a-small-brewery.html): How aseptic fruit purees work, when to add them, how to calculate their sugar contribution plus the refermentation risk in cans.
- [Attenuation limit tests and why every brewery should run one](https://craftbeerschool.in/attenuation-limit-tests-and-why-every-brewery-should-run-one.html): How to run an attenuation limit test, what the result tells you about your mash and your fermentation and why it settles arguments fast.
- [Auditing a host brewery before the first contract batch](https://craftbeerschool.in/auditing-a-host-brewery-before-the-first-contract-batch.html): A practical checklist for auditing a host brewery before your first contract batch: cleaning, lab, packaging, records and traceability.
- [Australian sparkling ale explained](https://craftbeerschool.in/australian-sparkling-ale-explained.html): Australian sparkling ale explained: a bottle-conditioned golden ale with Pride of Ringwood hops, lively carbonation and a cloudy pour.
- [Australian whisky explained](https://craftbeerschool.in/australian-whisky-explained.html): How Australian whisky grew from a handful of Tasmanian stills, what the rules require and the casks and flavours that mark the style.
- [Bacteria in long whisky fermentations](https://craftbeerschool.in/bacteria-in-long-whisky-fermentations.html): Which bacteria grow in long malt whisky fermentations, how lactic bacteria add fruit to new make and the signs that a wash has gone too far.
- [Balance in beer and how bitterness meets malt sweetness](https://craftbeerschool.in/balance-in-beer-and-how-bitterness-meets-malt-sweetness.html): What balance means in beer, how bitterness meets malt sweetness, the BU:GU ratio brewers use and the other factors that tip a beer one way.
- [Balancing a home kegerator so beer pours without foam](https://craftbeerschool.in/balancing-a-home-kegerator-so-beer-pours-without-foam.html): Why a home kegerator pours foam and how to balance pressure, line length and temperature so homebrew pours clear with a good head.
- [Balancing a long draw draught system in a busy bar](https://craftbeerschool.in/balancing-a-long-draw-draught-system-in-a-busy-bar.html): How to balance a long draw draught system: line resistance, lift, mixed gas blends and the pour rate a busy bar needs, with a worked example.
- [Ball valves, thermometers and sight glasses on a homebrew kettle](https://craftbeerschool.in/ball-valves-thermometers-and-sight-glasses-on-a-homebrew.html): What a ball valve, dial thermometer and sight glass do on a homebrew kettle, how to fit them without leaks and how to keep them clean.
- [Barley and aluminium price risk for finance teams](https://craftbeerschool.in/barley-and-aluminium-price-risk-for-finance-teams.html): Where barley and aluminium sit in beer cost, how their prices move and the contract and hedging tools finance teams use to manage them.
- [Barley contracts for malt whisky](https://craftbeerschool.in/barley-contracts-for-malt-whisky.html): How malt whisky distillers secure barley and malt in India: six-row and two-row, the specs that matter, contract types and crop risks.
- [Batch records and traceability in a distillery](https://craftbeerschool.in/batch-records-and-traceability-in-a-distillery.html): What batch records a whisky distillery should keep from grain to bottle, how to link them and how to run a simple trace drill.
- [Batch sparging versus fly sparging at home](https://craftbeerschool.in/batch-sparging-versus-fly-sparging-at-home.html): How batch and fly sparging work at home, the efficiency and time trade-off between them and which suits your mash tun and your patience.
- [Batch versus continuous distillation](https://craftbeerschool.in/batch-versus-continuous-distillation.html): How batch pot still distillation differs from continuous column distillation, what each does to flavour and cost and why whisky uses both.
- [Becoming a beer buyer for a bar or restaurant group](https://craftbeerschool.in/becoming-a-beer-buyer-for-a-bar-or-restaurant-group.html): What a beer buyer for a bar or restaurant group does: building the list, choosing suppliers, freshness, pour cost, staff training and how to get in.
- [Becoming a beer tour guide or brewery host](https://craftbeerschool.in/becoming-a-beer-tour-guide-or-brewery-host.html): What a brewery host or beer tour guide does, the brewing knowledge the job needs and how to get your first role in India.
- [Becoming a distiller in India](https://craftbeerschool.in/becoming-a-distiller-in-india.html): How people become distillers in India: the routes in, the skills plants expect, what the work involves and how to start learning.
- [Becoming a draught technician who installs and services taps](https://craftbeerschool.in/becoming-a-draught-technician-who-installs-and-services-taps.html): What a draught technician does: installing and servicing taps, balancing lines, cooling, gas and cleaning, plus the skills and routes into the job.
- [Becoming a whisky blender](https://craftbeerschool.in/becoming-a-whisky-blender.html): What a whisky blender does, the skills and training behind the role and the realistic path from lab or warehouse to the sample room.
- [Becoming a whisky educator](https://craftbeerschool.in/becoming-a-whisky-educator.html): How to become a whisky educator in India: the knowledge, the qualifications, running responsible tastings and finding your audience.
- [Becoming a yeast lab technician at a brewery or supplier](https://craftbeerschool.in/becoming-a-yeast-lab-technician-at-a-brewery-or-supplier.html): What a yeast lab technician does at a brewery or yeast supplier, the microbiology skills needed and how to get into the role.
- [Beer batch traceability explained for IT teams](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-batch-traceability-explained-for-it-teams.html): How beer moves from malt lots to brews, tanks, packaging runs and pallets. How IT teams can model the genealogy so a recall takes hours, not days.
- [Beer brand health tracking for insights teams](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-brand-health-tracking-for-insights-teams.html): How brand health tracking works for beer: the funnel measures, sample sizes, legal age rules and how to read movement honestly.
- [Beer brand portfolio reporting for finance analysts](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-brand-portfolio-reporting-for-finance-analysts.html): How finance analysts should report a beer brand portfolio: volume in hectolitres, margin per litre, mix effects and the beer facts behind them.
- [Beer case and pallet configurations for logistics teams](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-case-and-pallet-configurations-for-logistics-teams.html): How beer cases, trays and pallets are built, how to convert cases to hectolitres and why glass changes every load plan.
- [Beer cask finished whisky](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-cask-finished-whisky.html): How beer cask finishes work: which beer styles suit whisky, keeping casks clean in transit, finishing times, labelling rules and records.
- [Beer channel mix explained for GCC analysts](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-channel-mix-explained-for-gcc-analysts.html): What on-trade and off-trade mean for beer, how channel mix shapes volume, price and pack in India and how to report it well.
- [Beer consumer research methods for marketing teams](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-consumer-research-methods-for-marketing-teams.html): The main consumer research methods for beer: qualitative work, surveys and sensory tests, with when to use each and how to run tastings responsibly.
- [Beer etiquette in pubs abroad from rounds to tipping](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-etiquette-in-pubs-abroad-from-rounds-to-tipping.html): How ordering, rounds, toasts and tipping work in pubs and beer halls in the UK, Germany, Belgium, the Czech Republic, the US and Japan.
- [Beer festivals in India and how to make a weekend of one](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-festivals-in-india-and-how-to-make-a-weekend-of-one.html): How to turn an Indian beer festival into a weekend: when festivals happen, how to plan travel and stay, what to taste and how to stay safe.

- [Beer in hot weather and the dehydration myth](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-in-hot-weather-and-the-dehydration-myth.html): Does beer dehydrate you in hot weather? What alcohol does to your kidneys, why strength matters and how to enjoy cold beer safely in Indian heat.

- [Beer packaging materials explained for sustainability teams](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-packaging-materials-explained-for-sustainability-teams.html): Glass, cans, kegs, crowns, labels and cartons: what each beer pack is made of, where its footprint sits and what sustainability teams can change.
- [Beer pricing data quality problems analysts should spot](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-pricing-data-quality-problems-analysts-should-spot.html): The pricing data errors that distort beer dashboards in India, from pack size mix-ups to MRP changes plus how to catch them.
- [Beer product lifecycle from launch to delisting](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-product-lifecycle-from-launch-to-delisting.html): How a beer moves from idea to launch to delisting, what each stage needs from brewing, regulatory and commercial teams and the numbers to watch.
- [Beer promotions and how to measure if they worked](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-promotions-and-how-to-measure-if-they-worked.html): A practical method for judging beer promotions: set a baseline, measure uplift, subtract pull-forward and cannibalisation, then check the margin.
- [Beer returns and breakage claims for supply chain teams](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-returns-and-breakage-claims-for-supply-chain-teams.html): How beer breakage and returns happen, why excise makes them harder than other goods and how supply chain teams can cut claims at the source.
- [Beer route planning and delivery costs for logistics teams](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-route-planning-and-delivery-costs-for-logistics-teams.html): Why beer is expensive to move, how to calculate cost per case delivered and what route planners must allow for: weight, excise permits, heat and empties.
- [Beer seasonality data cleaning for forecasters](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-seasonality-data-cleaning-for-forecasters.html): How to clean beer sales history before forecasting: dry days, price changes, stock-outs, festivals and the Indian summer peak.
- [Beer terms in board packs explained for new joiners](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-terms-in-board-packs-explained-for-new-joiners.html): Hectolitres, NSR, mix, utilisation, ABV and the other beer terms that fill board packs, explained for new joiners without a brewing background.
- [Beer travel in Japan from craft bars to big brewery tours](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-travel-in-japan-from-craft-bars-to-big-brewery-tours.html): A guide to beer travel in Japan: big brewery tours, craft beer bars, izakaya habits, the drinking age and how to taste Japanese beer well.
- [Beer with brunch from eggs to pancakes](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-with-brunch-from-eggs-to-pancakes.html): Which beers suit eggs, bacon, pancakes and Indian breakfast plates at a weekend brunch, with low alcohol picks for daytime.
- [Beer with dim sum and Cantonese food](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-with-dim-sum-and-cantonese-food.html): Beer pairings for dim sum and Cantonese food: har gow, siu mai, char siu bao, cheung fun, roast duck, char siu and steamed fish.
- [Beer with fiery Andhra food and gongura dishes](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-with-fiery-andhra-food-and-gongura-dishes.html): Beer pairings for Andhra food: gongura mutton, gongura pachadi, Guntur chilli curries, pesarattu and biryani, plus how to manage heat.
- [Beer with fried fish and chips the British way](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-with-fried-fish-and-chips-the-british-way.html): Why bitter and pale ale suit fried fish and chips, what carbonation and vinegar do to the pairing and how to try it in India.
- [Beer with fruit platters and summer mangoes](https://craftbeerschool.in/beer-with-fruit-platters-and-summer-mangoes.html): Which beers suit Alphonso mangoes, watermelon, jackfruit and summer fruit platters, plus how to serve them in Indian heat.

## Facts

- Format: live online sessions plus hands-on in-person brewery workshops.
- Online schedule: Saturdays and Sundays, 12:00 PM to 2:00 PM IST, max 20 students per batch.
- Certificate of Completion needs all assignments and at least 80% attendance.
- Certification support: WSET and Cicerone preparation.
- Cohorts are deliberately small, with one-to-one mentorship.
- Contact: chatty@cheerschattyventures.com, +91-98209-25347.
